title: Padua/Pyrdiwah-Boraibari Border Clash
subtitle: April 2001 Bangladesh-India frontier fighting and rapid de-escalation.
summary: In April 2001, armed clashes broke out along sections of the Bangladesh-India border, centered first on the disputed Padua/Pyrdiwah area and then around Boraibari. The fighting between Bangladesh Rifles (BDR) and India's Border Security Force (BSF) caused military casualties on both sides and triggered urgent ceasefire diplomacy.
heroTagline: A short border war exposed long-standing fault lines in frontier management.
whyItMatters: The clash became one of the deadliest Bangladesh-India border episodes after 1971, highlighting how disputed alignment, force posture, and political signaling at the frontier could rapidly escalate into interstate crisis.
